findings.summary: The 1.9.2 Update notes overclaim what changed. In 1.9.1, deno.jsonc already needed the gate anywhere under the docs root (.jsonc was never a record), and pnpm-workspace.yaml already needed it outside feature and archive folders (only .md/.json are records there). What really changed: jsconfig*.json and deno.json anywhere under the docs root, and pnpm-workspace.yaml inside feature and archive folders; deno.jsonc is only named, no behavior change. Suggested fix: say jsconfig*.json and deno.json now need the gate anywhere under the docs root, and pnpm-workspace.yaml in feature and archive folders too; deno.jsonc already did and is now named a manifest. Coordinator asked for no overclaims, and the brief release section exists to correct this exact kind of record error in 1.9.1.
spec-6-2 is untraced: the spec says release-preparation.test.ts passes unchanged, so no [AC:spec-6-2] tag can be added without changing it. Evidence is the passing run plus the empty diff.
The cleanup line says new-doc skips a Backlog/ folder in any case; backlogFile (cleanup.mjs:185) is also used by the working-file check at cleanup.mjs:879. An under-claim, not wrong.
findings.assumption: An under-claim in release notes is acceptable.
